pinning_policy: pinned build tag; never fetch 'latest' implicitly. `local-ai update` may move this pin explicitly.

variants.sha256_status: NOT_PRESENT — upstream publishes no per-asset checksum; verified by archive integrity, expected asset size, and post-install `llama-server --version` check
variants.preferred_for: modern NVIDIA GPUs (Blackwell / Ada / newer Ampere)
older NVIDIA GPUs not supported by CUDA 13 builds

extract_layout: zip contains llama-server.exe, llama-cli.exe and backend DLLs at archive root
notes: Version b10375 is the build used by Reasoning Budget Arena for its frozen Formal C runs, so Arena benchmark evidence is directly applicable to this runtime.
